threatModel.summary: Jubarte is a local Word document processing engine exposed through Rust byte APIs, a native CLI, Python/PyO3 APIs and CLI, a Python stdio MCP server, and JavaScript/WASM APIs plus a Node CLI. It admits DOCX packages, parses XML into an arena DOM, compares or edits documents, and produces DOCX, Markdown, inspection reports, PDF and PNG output. Legacy DOC conversion is a separate OLE parser. Rendering uses bundled, embedded and native installed fonts. Filesystem authority belongs to host adapters: the MCP adapter grants a persistent directory capability, whereas local CLIs use ambient process authority. The native CLI additionally offers an explicit GitHub self-update operation. Tag-triggered CI publishes release artifacts; a separate maintainer script publishes package registries. findings.summary: Admitted DOCX gridSpan, gridBefore and gridAfter values become allocation lengths without a semantic column or derived-work budget. A tiny table can exhaust the rendering process.

severity.rationale: High-likelihood document-controlled process denial of service; impact is availability of the embedding renderer, with deployment-wide impact unknown. Host memory/CPU isolation can limit the blast radius.

confidence.rationale: The complete input-to-allocation path and absence of semantic bounds were independently confirmed in current source; no dynamic exploit was run.

codeEvidence.label: Self-hosted private shared cache without token
codeEvidence.code:
# The self-hosted runners share one mbx cache server on their private Docker
# network (`mbx-cache`), so a crate one runner compiled is a cache hit on the
# others. The server takes no token: mbx sends none over plain HTTP, and only
# the runners can reach it. mbx publishes only from pushes to a protected
# branch; pull requests read. GitHub-hosted runners cannot reach the server,
# so jobs that also run there keep Swatinem/rust-cache on those legs.
runs:
  using: composite
  steps:
    - uses: jdx/mr-boxington-action@47ce49b32025d93a7a2f4570815afaa2b7092240 # v1.7.2
      with:
        backend: remote
        version: "1.24.1"
        remote-url: http://mbx-cache:7543
        namespace: jandira-tech/jubarte-redlines

codeEvidence.label: Runner checkout and disk are reused
codeEvidence.code:
# Every job on a runner builds in the same checkout, so mbx always counts
    # that checkout's managed target as the most recently used and never
    # collects it: on 2026-10-17 three of them reached 69-220 GiB in a few
    # hours and filled the disk the four runners share. Each job now starts
    # from an empty target, restored from the store and the cache server,
    # and each runner's store keeps to a fixed share of the disk.
    - name: bound mbx's disk use
      shell: bash
      run: |
        echo "MBX_GC_MAX_TOTAL_SIZE=20GiB" >> "$GITHUB_ENV"
        mbx clean --under "$GITHUB_WORKSPACE"
        MBX_GC_MAX_TOTAL_SIZE=20GiB mbx gc
codeEvidence.explanation: Runner checkout and disk are reused
